name: elysium-mainnet-v2-factory
_rpc: Kinetiq's public mainnet RPC. Fine for the deploy; the keeper and site may need a heavier one (docs/MAINNET-V2.md).
_poolManager: Uniswap's official v4 PoolManager on Elysium (developers.uniswap.org/deployments?chain=Elysium).
_launchFeeBps: 1.5% of a successful raise, taken at settlement. At most 300 (3%). Decided Nov 10 (docs/MAINNET-DECISIONS.md, A1).
_launchFloors: Every launch puts at least 50% of its raise into its pool, and its pool reserve must cover that share. No minimum raise is required (0): a creator may still set one, and under it the launch fails and every deposit comes back. Raising either floor later is instant; lowering waits 3 days in public. Decided Nov 11.
_caps: Beta bid caps: 100 HYPE per bid, 10,000 HYPE per launch, until the audit. Decided Nov 10 (docs/MAINNET-DECISIONS.md, A3).
_hook: Pool fee in pips (1e6 = 100%): 0.3% base, 10% at listing falling to 0.3% over 5 minutes. 20% of all of it to the treasury (CloakConfig feeRecipient), 80% to the creator: PROTOCOL_SHARE_BPS in the hook (decided Nov 10). Fixed in the hook for good.
_owner: Mainnet owner wallet (docs/WALLETS.md). Calls acceptOwnership() on the config right after the deploy.
_vaultVerifier: Gloam's mainnet verifier (unused by v2; CloakConfig needs a non-zero address).
